units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 39:4">Targ. Y. Gen. XXXIX, 4</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 39a:9">B. Mets. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>מעמידין א׳</he> the court appoints an administrator.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:1:14">Y. Ter. I, 40ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ לעולם</he> a permanent administrator (guardian), <he>א׳ לשעה</he> a temporary administrator (substitute).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 46">Ex. R. s. 46</cite> <he>מתגדלת אצל א׳</he> reared in the house of a guardian; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 121a:5">Sabb. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ של מלך</he> royal administrator (of the fiscus).—Trnsf.

<cite ref="Ketubot 13b:7">Keth. 13ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אין א׳ לעריות</he> there is no guardian (no means of guarding) against inchastity; Y. ib. I, 25ᵈ top <he>א׳ על עריות</he>.—Pl. <he>אֶפִּיטְרוֹפְסִים</he>, <he>אֶפִּיטְרוֹפְסִין</he>, <he>אַפַּטְרְפִין אֶפִּיטְרוֹפִין</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 41:34">Targ. Y. Gen. XLI, 34</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Terumot 5:7">Tosef. Ter. V, 7</cite> <he>תרומת א׳</he> T’rumah set apart by administrators in behalf of minors. Y.
